worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.summary: After preparing, sharply raise Speed. This increase ends when the effect expires.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.use.0: Stand and polish once before a fight to cap Speed
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.use.1: Use the visible shine window to force the opponent to stall
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.use.2: Polish the stone underfoot and mark the ground
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.description: Speed +%1$s level(s) after polishing; standing still to grind takes %2$s.
The shine lasts about %1$s and polishes %2$s blocks of stone ground; the levels are taken back when it dulls.
After a pass, it recovers for %1$s and starts a %2$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.grit.on: Fine grit: longer wind-up and cooldown, a larger floor circle and a longer shine; even light bodies reach the maximum.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.grit.off: Coarse grit: shorter wind-up and cooldown, a smaller floor circle and a shorter shine; bodies over 100kg still reach the maximum.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.growth.0: At level %1$s the shine extends to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rockpolish.growth.1: At level %1$s the shine extends further to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
Coarse: shorter wind-up and cooldown, a smaller floor mark and a shorter shine; Fine: longer wind-up and cooldown, a larger floor circle and a longer shine, and even light bodies reach the maximum.
The companion considers polishing only when a threat is within this distance; larger means earlier preparation.
Below this distance the companion stops polishing and deals with the threat; larger gives up the boost more often up close.
